body:
Hi Berryhill team,

I read through berryhillsewerservice.com this week. You have been serving West Texas since 1946, which is a remarkable story, but the website does not do it justice. Whole blocks of the page are repeated twice: your serving area, contact details, and business hours all appear two times on the same page, and your services are buried in one long scroll on an old template. Most visitors will never reach the parts that make you different.

So I redesigned your homepage, and the PDF is attached to this email. It leads with your since 1946, family-owned, veteran-owned story, lays out septic pumping, grease traps, and portable rentals in a clean services section, and keeps your phone number visible from top to bottom.

Home service sites are my specialty. I built Big Birge Plumbing (bigbirgeplumbing.com), a plumbing company website with clear services and simple booking. I also built Herman Plumbing (hermanplumbing.net), designed around trust and easy contact.

If you like the direction, I can put it live on your domain and build the rest of the pages. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no strings attached.

Best,
Hassan
name: Berryhill Sewer Service Inc.
subject: 🚛 Your homepage repeats its own contact blocks twice
